title: Intelligaia doc_spec
description: Content contract for build_docx.js. The model fills this; the script makes it on-brand. Never invent facts — use [TK: …] for gaps.

eyebrow.description: Small caps label / doc type, e.g. 'Description', 'Proposal', 'Discovery Questionnaire'.

company.description: Defaults to 'Intelligaia'. Shown in the cover 'Prepared by' line.

client.description: REQUIRED on the cover. Who the document is for. Ask if missing; render [TK: client] if unknown.

project.description: REQUIRED on the cover. The project/engagement this doc belongs to. Ask if missing.

purpose.description: REQUIRED on the cover. One line on why this document exists. Ask if missing.

docId.description: Reference id, shown on the cover meta line.

draft.description: Adds a DRAFT mark on the cover.

treatment.description: Client-adaptive treatment; 'technical' = mono labels + tighter grid (deep-tech clients).

text.description: For h1/h2/lede/body/callout/quote. Body/bullets/table cells support **bold** for navy-bold emphasis.

items.description: For bullets/numbered, and for contents (section names).

muted.description: For kv: render values as grey hint text (template/example asks).

answer.description: For qa. Use \n to split paragraphs.

number.description: For qform: the item number, e.g. '1.1'.

hint.description: For qform: optional grey hint shown inside the response box.

lines.description: For qform: approximate blank lines of height in the response box (default 2).

assetId.description: manifest.json asset id (figure). Resolved to raw_url + dimensions.

path.description: manifest path fallback for a figure.

rawUrl.description: Direct PNG url for a figure.

localPath.description: Local PNG path for a figure (e.g. a user-supplied diagram).
